featured_reviews.review_text:
First things first, the staff both at the building and at the coworking space were polite and lovely. However, that is the only positive thing I have to say. This may be the worst coworking space I have ever been to, and I'm genuinely shocked that they even market it as a coworking space.

What it is is a glorified cafe - if you get a day pass and try to work here, they shove you into a random table in the corner of their lunch room (picture attached), with uncomfortable and unergonomic chairs. My shoulder started hurting within a few minutes of sitting here.

Since it is their lunch room, it's also not quiet - so not suitable for working, and definitely not suitable for taking calls or meetings. There is no room for taking calls.

There is coffee and water, but you have to take it in a tiny paper cup (photo attached). I don't think they even had crockery or cutlery to eat lunch with.

To make matters worse, the address they send of the location on Google Maps is wrong (wrong side of the street), and getting to the space is an absolute maze and none of this is explained beforehand. You have to hand full a register on the ground floor, take a lift up one floor, walk out and past a Starbucks, then go through another gate, where you will find lifts of which only one of them actually goes to the 25th floor. It took me 20 minutes to go from the entrance of the building to the entrance of the space.

The bathroom is fine, and I guess there's a view if you're into that - but it was a hazy day.

I left in an hour and went home, which for myself and most people will be significantly quieter, more productive and more comfortable. I can't believe I paid money to work here and was in half a mind to ask for a refund.

I visited the location on June 2025, and at that time, the auto rickshaw fare from Andheri station was ₹30 per person, while it was approximately ₹20 per person if you’re coming from Chakala or Western Express Highway stations. This might vary slightly depending on time and traffic, but it gives a good estimate for planning your commute.
One major drawback of this location is the complete lack of food or snack options nearby. There are no eateries or stalls in the vicinity, so if you’re heading there for a meeting or spending a few hours, it is advisable to carry your own water and some food. Another point to keep in mind is that there’s no designated waiting area or benches outside the office premises. Additionally, the receptionist is quite particular and won’t permit visitors to sit for extended periods in the lobby, so it’s best to arrive just on time for your appointment.
